_doc: plan-5497 S0: every place a secret is ALLOWED to live, named by path, never by value. A copy anywhere else is a leak or an undeclared holder; tests/test_secretset.py (L.4) scans the SCAN_ROOTS and goes RED on any secret-bearing file not listed here. `fate`: keep = by design; retire = a dead copy to delete (no live reader); expire = a temporary copy with a deadline (BC-2). `readers` = who needs it (a2's rule: before REMOVING a copy, enumerate its readers: backup, restore, rollback, fresh-host init).

holders.note: until S1c the DB password lives here too; after S1c only the tokens and ASTRYX_SECRET_KEY (BC-b)

readers: node-pg only with HOME or PGPASSFILE
holders.note: after S1c the ONLY holder of the DB password; backup.sh must capture it (a2 #27944)

readers: genesis-pg compose (POSTGRES_PASSWORD, read at initdb only)
holders.note: stale-but-inert after rotation unless rewritten; the container env keeps whatever it was created with
served by `docker inspect` to the docker group (root-equivalent)
OBSERVER_DSN; S1c makes it password-less (the observer venv authenticates via ~/.pgpass under a bare env, census 09-30)
no unit reads it: astryx-geoloc.service uses astryx/.env. Holds the DB password, GEOLOC_TOKEN and the AUTOREMOTE key
all 11 genesis-* units that reference it are inactive; holds WA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
carries .env on purpose; after S1c also ~/.pgpass
holds the DB password while turns.raw_payload does; ages out by keep-last-N after S1a + the one-time UPDATE
RULE, not a file: a symlink to the live .env or the clone-role DSN only, never a copy (a2 #27600; plan-4918)
